children: Caterpillar renewed and expanded its liquidity framework by securing a new $3.5 billion unsecured 364-day revolving credit facility with multicurrency options and by extending its $3.0 billion three-year and $5.0 billion five-year revolving credit facilities to 2029 and 2031, respectively. The 2026 364-day facility allows borrowing in pounds sterling, euros and Japanese yen within the aggregate commitment. Concurrently, the 2025 364-day facility expired and was replaced by the new line. The company reported no borrowings outstanding under the facilities at the time of filing.
Agreement 1: Caterpillar Secures $3.5 Billion 364-Day Credit Facility With Multicurrency Options
: Unsecured 364-day revolving credit facility with local currency addendums
: Citibank as Agent, MUFG Bank as Japan Local Currency Agent, and other lenders
: Refinance short-term liquidity and add currency flexibility
Agreement 2: Caterpillar Extends $3.0 Billion Three-Year Revolving Credit Facility to 2029
: Unsecured three-year revolving credit facility (amended and restated)
: Citibank as Agent and other lenders
: Extend maturity and maintain committed liquidity
Agreement 3: Caterpillar Extends $5.0 Billion Five-Year Revolving Credit Facility to 2031
: Unsecured five-year revolving credit facility (amended and restated)
: Citibank as Agent and other lenders
: Extend maturity and maintain committed liquidity
Agreement 4: Caterpillar 2025 364-Day Credit Facility Expires, Replaced by New $3.5 Billion Line
: 2025 364-day revolving credit facility and related local currency addendums
: Citibank as Agent and other lenders
